usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the RPN calculator in `main.wj`. It gives the expected output on both of your examples when run with `wj run --interpret`. An extra check, `-7 2 /`, gave `-3`, so division truncates toward zero.

`wj build main.wj` also succeeds, so it compiles with the production compiler. I didn't write any `*_test.wj` tests or try other inputs, such as large 64-bit values.

The program skips blank and w
